name: frs-recon-backend
description: Node.js + PostgreSQL API for insurance policy PDF extraction (FRS - Recon)

scripts.init-db: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const db = require('./src/db'); db.ensureDatabase().then(() => db.ensureSchema()).then(() => { console.log('schema ready'); process.exit(0); }).catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.test-unit: node scripts/test-unit-rule.js && node scripts/test-unit-pass.js && node scripts/test-payu-settlement.js && node scripts/test-easebuzz-rule.js && node scripts/test-contra-pass.js && node scripts/test-cheque-parsers.js && node scripts/test-audit-report.js && node scripts/test-card-matcher.js && node scripts/test-upi-matcher.js && node scripts/test-detect-file-type.js && node scripts/test-gateway-policy.js && node scripts/test-easebuzz-window.js
